name: Cochlear hair cell
failures: Noise, ototoxic and age-related loss. Birds regenerate these; mammals do not.

see.note: Audiometry measures function, not cells. No way to image hair cells in a living human.

model.note: Avian regeneration shows the target state exists biologically.

reach.note: Intracochlear injection works but the cochlea is small, fluid-filled and easily damaged.

edit.note: OTOF gene therapy restored hearing in congenitally deaf children, 2024 trials. One genotype.
